command: set -u; echo '=== HOST ==='; hostname; id -un; uptime; free -m | sed -n '1,2p'; echo '=== FRANK COMMAND ==='; command -v frank || true; type -a frank 2>/dev/null || true; [ -e "$HOME/.local/bin/frank" ] && ls -l "$HOME/.local/bin/frank" || true; echo '=== LIVE STAR ==='; for f in "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_aider.py" "$HOME/.claude/star/harness_audit.py" "$HOME/.claude/star/stern.py"; do [ -f "$f" ] && sha256sum "$f"; done; echo '=== REPOS ==='; for r in "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/self-integration"; do if [ -d "$r/.git" ]; then echo "-- $r"; git -C "$r" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$r" branch --show-current; git -C "$r" status --porcelain=v1 | head -40; fi; done; echo '=== SERVICES ==='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== PROCESSES ==='; pgrep -af 'harness_aider|aider|stern.py|frank|entityos' | head -40 || true
